where: Théorème 5.4, first line: 'et A_K un schéma abélien sur S ayant une réduction semi-stable sur S'
scan: A_K un schéma abélien sur S ayant une réduction semi-stable sur S ('un schéma abélien sur' underlined, S plain)
note: A_K is an abelian scheme over the fraction field K (it has semi-stable reduction over S); the exposé writes 'A_K un schéma abélien sur K' in its other statements. The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

scan: et on aura alors: the second letter is typed over a u (the glyph shows both the arch and feet of n and the bowl of u) and the o is struck twice, i.e. the typist retyped 'ou' as 'on'
note: The TeX gives the reading before the typist's correction. If the overstrike is read as 'ou' instead, this becomes a misprint of the print that the TeX keeps (fix null, corrected 'et on aura alors').

scan: T_ℓ(A')/T_ℓ(A'_K)^f ≃ M'_K ⊗_Z Z_ℓ . (no index K on the first A')
note: The index K is missing on the first A' (compare the first line of (5.5.8) and both lines of (5.5.9)). The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

where: first line: 'où on se rappelera que les groupes'
scan: où on se rappelera que les groupes
note: Spelling error of the typescript (appeler doubles the l before a mute e), as on p. 283. The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

where: Proposition 5.6: '(qui peut être égal à la caractéristique résiduelle de S)'
scan: (qui peut être égal à la carac-téristique résiduelle de S): the underline starts under 'qui'; the opening parenthesis is not underlined
tex: \underline{(qui peut être égal à la caractéristique résiduelle de} $S$)
note: The TeX puts the opening parenthesis inside the underline; compare (\underline{fibre spéciale de la biextension} on p. 377, where it stays outside.

scan: le pro-ℓ-groupe de Barsotti-Tate: 'le pro' and 'groupe de Barsotti-Tate' underlined; the handwritten ℓ and the hyphens on either side of it are not underlined
note: The TeX runs the underline under the handwritten ℓ, which the print, as with every other math symbol of the statement, leaves without underline.

where: 5.6.1: 'cela signifie respectivement que S' déploye les groupes'
scan: respectivement que S' déploye les groupes
note: Spelling error of the typescript (verbs in -oyer take i before a mute e; the volume has 'qui déploie F_K' elsewhere). The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

where: 5.6.1: 'que S' déploye les groupes constants tordus M et M''
scan: les groupes constants tordus M et M' (M, M' underlined)
note: The pairing contradicts 'respectivement': by (5.5.7) T_ℓ(A_K)^t is given by M' (T_ℓ(A^o)^t ≃ M̌' ⊗ Z_ℓ(1)), and by (5.5.8) T_ℓ(A_K)/T_ℓ(A_K)^f by M. Probably an authorial slip, harmless since M and M' are isogenous; the emendation is conjectural. The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

scan: qui fait l'affaire. Between 'fait' and 'l'affaire' there is only a speck (about 4x4 px, above the baseline); the typewriter's full stop on the same line is about 11x12 px and sits on the baseline
note: The TeX turns a speck into a full stop. If the mark is judged a lightly typed stray stop, this becomes a misprint of the print that the TeX keeps (fix null, corrected 'fait l'affaire').
